name: data: download a dataset and compute over it in run_python
description: Tier 2. The data path the plan scenarios never touch: fetch real dataset bytes to the browser filesystem, then compute over the file with run_python. The fixture is 61 lines against a 50-line preview cap, so summing the preview instead of reading the file yields 58800 rather than 96000 — a wrong answer that is visibly wrong. This is the regime where inline dataset content used to break tool-call JSON on tabs and newlines.
inputs: Download the transactions table in this history and tell me the sum of all values in the Price column. Compute it, do not estimate.
